completion_criteria.criterion: The machine pre-check covers every page of all 30 main samples and finds no substantive difference.
completion_criteria.evidence: The pre-check reads 30 documents and 35 pages, compares every observed evidence value with the extracted text or the gold decision, and records image-only fields as pending human visual review.

completion_criteria.criterion: annotations.lock.json binds the final source files and gold records and records the reviewed decisions.
completion_criteria.evidence: Every lock entry carries the source byte SHA-256, the gold SHA-256, the missing, unreadable, ambiguous and routing decisions, and the pending human status.

completion_criteria.criterion: reports/annotation_review.json covers every page of all 30 main samples and the boundary fixtures, and records zero disputes.
completion_criteria.evidence: The report lists every page with its preview and its machine result, covers the 18 content and 4 technical fixtures, the 4 object-level cases and da-fx-unread, and separates pending human items from disputes.

completion_criteria.criterion: datasets/docuagents_v1/README.md states every P7 item, including the scoring range, isolation, commands, seeds and limitations.
completion_criteria.evidence: The README has the required sections: purpose, matrix, fixtures, gold and codes, scoring, readability, isolation, commands, seeds, upstream, environment, freeze process, model input restrictions, limitations, licence and test visibility.

completion_criteria.criterion: The licence and attribution statements are separate and complete.
completion_criteria.evidence: NOTICE and the README state the upstream MIT code licence, the upstream CC BY 4.0 data licence, the new MIT code licence and the new CC BY 4.0 data licence separately; the upstream files are unchanged.

completion_criteria.criterion: The three frozen files are in the main manifest and the end-to-end check passes on the final version.
completion_criteria.evidence: The manifest declares annotations.lock.json, reports/annotation_review.json and README.md with the frozen_review role; the acceptance run is recorded in the task completion report.

completion_criteria.criterion: The controlled re-freeze leaves all 142 main, 64 fixture and 100 injection artifacts byte-identical.
completion_criteria.evidence: The manifest changes are limited to the three new entries, the generator fields and the run report; the acceptance run compares the generated bytes with the reference.

completion_criteria.criterion: The existing and new tests pass offline with no skip and no xfail.
completion_criteria.evidence: The task completion report records the pytest command, the passed count and the absence of skip and xfail.

completion_criteria.criterion: The human sign-off, the tag and the formal release record are completed by the Project Owner.
completion_criteria.evidence: This report stays pending_human_confirmation. The tag docuagents-v1.0, the signed review and the formal release record are not created by this task.

completion_criteria_source: These nine criteria are derived from the T17 acceptance clauses and the D1-D10 deliverables in the task instruction. The Notion section §8.1 text is not in this repository, so no Notion text is quoted or invented here.
confirmation_path: The Project Owner reviews every page preview and the listed manual items, signs this report, and updates the lock status. Until then this report and the lock stay pending_human_confirmation: an agent cannot sign them.
dispute_resolution: No substantive dispute was found by the machine pre-check. The manual items are pending human confirmation; they are not counted as resolved or disputed.
